# Coding Manual for Human Validation

This manual defines the coding scheme used to validate computational estimates of meta-communication.

## Coding Levels

### N1 — Descriptive Content
- Plain reporting
- Narrative description
- No explicit framing of discourse

### N2 — Meta-Communicative Framing
- Organizational or editorial markers
- Statements about explanation, clarification, structure

Examples:
- “I will now explain…”
- “In other words…”

### N3 — Normative Ontological Meta-Communication
- Claims about reality structure
- Ontological authority statements
- Integration of discourse and world-model

Examples:
- “The order of the world…”
- “These rays governed…”

## Instructions

- Code each segment independently
- Assign only one level (N1, N2, N3)
- Remain blind to computational scores

## Output Format

Raters should complete:

- `validation_template.csv`
- columns: `raterA`, `raterB`
